**Daily Devotional**

**April 1**

*17 The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing. (Zephaniah 3:17 KJV)*

This whole book of Zephaniah is announcing the harsh judgments on the Nation of Israel for their sins, and yet in the midst of the prophecy the Lord tells of a future time that He will again have mercy on them, and joy with them. Only our God could have such forgiveness and mercy on us sinners, and although He brings judgment now on only the unsaved, He will again pour out His mercy on us humans, although we do not deserve it. This of course will change when Jesus comes again, as it will be in final judgment, and the unbelievers will be thrown into the lake of fire (Revelation 20:15). Those that claim everyone will go to heaven in the end are absolutely wrong according to scripture, as Jesus said few would (Matthew 7:14).

This again demonstrates the fact that God is Love (1 John 4:8). It is so amazing that our Heavenly Father, who is so Holy, would have such love and compassion on us fallen humans, that He still gets pleasure out of giving us mercy and forgiveness. We were, and are, created for His pleasure (Revelation 4:11), praise God, and He still wants to fellowship with us all. All us Christians need to thank God daily for His grace, mercy and love, as it is beyond human ability to understand how much the Father loves us humans, His creation. Thank you Father for loving us so much.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
